article.title: Discharge of President's functions in other contingencies
article.content: Parliament may make such provision as it thinks fit for the discharge of the functions of the President in any contingency not provided for in this Chapter.
article.html:
70Discharge of President's functions in other contingencies

Article 70 · Part V · The President and Vice-President

Parliament may make such provision as it thinks fit for the discharge of the functions of the President in any contingency not provided for in this Chapter.
